# electrical

IES LM-63 photometrics, normal illuminance, NFPA 101 / IBC emergency egress checks, and 2D plan overlays.

Every example below is a complete script that passes the kit's checks; the kit's tests run each one.

- [`electrical.setLuminaireIes`](#electricalsetluminaireies): Attaches a built-in IES profile id (troffer_2x4_led, downlight_6_led, linear_pendant_led, exit_combo_wall_pack, exterior_wall_pack_led) or custom IES LM-63 text (optionally saved once in the photometric_profile catalog), plus emergency driver/battery and LLF metadata, to one or more placed luminaires or all instances of a luminaire part type.
- [`electrical.runPhotometrics`](#electricalrunphotometrics): Runs point-by-point IES LM-63 normal illuminance, 4-bounce spatially-resolved diffuse patch radiosity, optional CIE daylighting, and ASHRAE 90.1 LPD across active spaces/rooms on the script's live working model.
- [`electrical.runDaylightAnalysis`](#electricalrundaylightanalysis): Runs a CIE Sky Dome + direct solar beam daylighting and Daylight Factor (DF%) study across active spaces/rooms with 4-bounce diffuse patch radiosity, glazing visible transmittance (T_vis), and 3D wall/ceiling/roof/furniture occlusion (skyModel: "cie_overcast" | "cie_clear" | "cie_intermediate").
- [`electrical.exportRadiance`](#electricalexportradiance): Exports the live working model into standard LBNL Radiance scene text files (`materialsRad`, `geometryRad`, `luminairesRad`, `skyRad`, `sensorGridPts`, `iesFiles`, and `oconv`/`rtrace`/`rpict`/`evalglare` commands) using exact kernel.material LRV/T_vis and luminaire IES webs — zero runtime Radiance dependency.
- [`electrical.runEgressLightingCheck`](#electricalrunegresslightingcheck): Runs NFPA 101 §7.9.2.1 / IBC §1008.3.5 emergency egress lighting compliance (initial ≥1.0 avg / ≥0.1 min fc and 90-minute ≥0.6 avg / ≥0.06 min fc, max:min ≤40:1) using strictly emergency-backed fixtures along corridors, 3D multi-flight stair treads/landings, exit discharge pads, or explicit egress paths (supports calculationMode: "simplified" | "detailed").
- [`electrical.enablePhotometricOverlay`](#electricalenablephotometricoverlay): Toggles the 2D photometric footcandle grid, marching-squares iso-contour lines, and sub-threshold fail highlights on a floor or ceiling plan view (mode: "off" | "normal" | "egress").
- [`electrical.insertDisconnect`](#electricalinsertdisconnect): Places a local NEMA 3R/1 disconnect switch beside an equipment load (NEC 440.14 / 430.102) and re-routes its circuit inline (panel -> disconnect -> equipment) while preserving upstream breaker positions and One-Line topology.
- [`electrical.removeDisconnect`](#electricalremovedisconnect): Removes an inline local disconnect switch feeding a piece of equipment and restores direct feed from its upstream panel circuit (preserving breaker positions and ratings).
- [`electrical.setDisconnectRequirement`](#electricalsetdisconnectrequirement): Marks whether a piece of equipment requires a local disconnect switch (set required: false for integral factory disconnects or lockable breakers per NEC 430.102(B) Exception to silence equipment-missing-disconnect warnings).

## electrical.setLuminaireIes

Attaches a built-in IES profile id (troffer_2x4_led, downlight_6_led, linear_pendant_led, exit_combo_wall_pack, exterior_wall_pack_led) or custom IES LM-63 text (optionally saved once in the photometric_profile catalog), plus emergency driver/battery and LLF metadata, to one or more placed luminaires or all instances of a luminaire part type.

```ts
setLuminaireIes(ctx: ScriptContext, target: string | PlacedPart | readonly (string | PlacedPart)[], spec: LuminaireIesSpec): void
```

Topics: ies, photometrics, luminaire, emergency battery, egress lighting, llf, candela

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, markups, drafting, checks, electrical } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "layout",
  reads: { levels: true },
  parameters: {},
  run(ctx) {
    const lt = equipment.place(ctx, { level: "L1", type: "builtin:troffer-2x4-led@1", at: { x: units.ft(8), y: units.ft(8) }, height: units.ft(9), mark: "F1" });
    electrical.setLuminaireIes(ctx, lt, { profile: "troffer_2x4_led", emergencyMode: "battery_pack", emergencyLumens: 1400, egressFixture: true, lld: 0.9, ldd: 0.92 });
  },
});
```

</details>

## electrical.runPhotometrics

Runs point-by-point IES LM-63 normal illuminance, 4-bounce spatially-resolved diffuse patch radiosity, optional CIE daylighting, and ASHRAE 90.1 LPD across active spaces/rooms on the script's live working model. Supports calculationMode: "simplified" (empty shell plane + cavity bounce), "detailed" (default — Materials Library LRV/T_vis, 4-bounce patch radiosity, glazing transmittance, furniture & stair occlusion), and "surfaces" (also evaluates actual kitchen countertops, islands, worktables, vanities & rising 3D stair treads).

```ts
runPhotometrics<T = unknown>(ctx: ScriptContext, spec?: PhotometricsRunSpec): T
```

Topics: photometrics, footcandles, illuminance, lpd, ashrae 90.1, lighting calculation, materials, surfaces, countertop, stairs, radiosity, daylight

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, markups, drafting, checks, electrical } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "layout",
  reads: { levels: true },
  parameters: {},
  run(ctx) {
    const walls = building.walls(ctx, { level: "L1", points: [{ x: units.ft(0), y: units.ft(0) }, { x: units.ft(30), y: units.ft(0) }, { x: units.ft(30), y: units.ft(20) }, { x: units.ft(0), y: units.ft(20) }], closed: true, thickness: units.in(8), height: units.ft(10) });
    building.room(ctx, { level: "L1", number: "101", name: "Open Office", outline: [{ x: units.ft(0), y: units.ft(0) }, { x: units.ft(30), y: units.ft(0) }, { x: units.ft(30), y: units.ft(20) }, { x: units.ft(0), y: units.ft(20) }] });
    const f1 = equipment.place(ctx, { level: "L1", type: "builtin:troffer-2x4-led@1", at: { x: units.ft(10), y: units.ft(10) }, height: units.ft(9), mark: "F1" });
    electrical.setLuminaireIes(ctx, f1, { profile: "troffer_2x4_led" });
    const res = electrical.runPhotometrics(ctx, { gridSpacing: units.ft(2), workplaneHeight: units.in(30), calculationMode: "surfaces" });
    ctx.report("Normal photometrics", res);
  },
});
```

</details>

```ts
    building.room(ctx, { level: "L1", number: "101", name: "Open Office", outline: [{ x: units.ft(0), y: units.ft(0) }, { x: units.ft(30), y: units.ft(0) }, { x: units.ft(30), y: units.ft(20) }, { x: units.ft(0), y: units.ft(20) }] });
```

## electrical.runEgressLightingCheck

Runs NFPA 101 §7.9.2.1 / IBC §1008.3.5 emergency egress lighting compliance (initial ≥1.0 avg / ≥0.1 min fc and 90-minute ≥0.6 avg / ≥0.06 min fc, max:min ≤40:1) using strictly emergency-backed fixtures along corridors, 3D multi-flight stair treads/landings, exit discharge pads, or explicit egress paths (supports calculationMode: "simplified" | "detailed").

```ts
runEgressLightingCheck<T = unknown>(ctx: ScriptContext, spec?: EgressLightingCheckSpec): T
```

Topics: egress lighting, emergency lighting, nfpa 101, ibc 1008, 90-minute, life safety, exit discharge, stairs

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, markups, drafting, checks, electrical } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "layout",
  reads: { levels: true },
  parameters: {},
  run(ctx) {
    const walls = building.walls(ctx, { level: "L1", points: [{ x: units.ft(0), y: units.ft(0) }, { x: units.ft(30), y: units.ft(0) }, { x: units.ft(30), y: units.ft(20) }, { x: units.ft(0), y: units.ft(20) }], closed: true, thickness: units.in(8), height: units.ft(10) });
    building.room(ctx, { level: "L1", number: "100", name: "Main Corridor", outline: [{ x: units.ft(0), y: units.ft(0) }, { x: units.ft(30), y: units.ft(0) }, { x: units.ft(30), y: units.ft(8) }, { x: units.ft(0), y: units.ft(8) }] });
    const em1 = equipment.place(ctx, { level: "L1", type: "builtin:troffer-2x4-led-em@1", at: { x: units.ft(8), y: units.ft(4) }, height: units.ft(9), mark: "EM1" });
    const em2 = equipment.place(ctx, { level: "L1", type: "builtin:troffer-2x4-led-em@1", at: { x: units.ft(22), y: units.ft(4) }, height: units.ft(9), mark: "EM2" });
    electrical.setLuminaireIes(ctx, [em1, em2], { profile: "troffer_2x4_led", emergencyMode: "battery_pack", emergencyLumens: 1400, egressFixture: true });
    const res = electrical.runEgressLightingCheck(ctx, { gridSpacing: units.ft(2) });
    ctx.report("Egress lighting", res);
  },
});
```

</details>

## electrical.enablePhotometricOverlay

Toggles the 2D photometric footcandle grid, marching-squares iso-contour lines, and sub-threshold fail highlights on a floor or ceiling plan view (mode: "off" | "normal" | "egress").

```ts
enablePhotometricOverlay(ctx: ScriptContext, viewRef: string, spec: PhotometricOverlaySpec): void
```

Topics: photometric overlay, iso-contours, footcandle grid, egress plan, life safety plan

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, markups, drafting, checks, electrical } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "layout",
  reads: { levels: true },
  parameters: {},
  run(ctx) {
    const walls = building.walls(ctx, { level: "L1", points: [{ x: units.ft(0), y: units.ft(0) }, { x: units.ft(30), y: units.ft(0) }, { x: units.ft(30), y: units.ft(20) }, { x: units.ft(0), y: units.ft(20) }], closed: true, thickness: units.in(8), height: units.ft(10) });
    const plan = documents.planView(ctx, { level: "L1", name: "Level 1 - Plan", scale: 48 });
    electrical.enablePhotometricOverlay(ctx, plan, { mode: "egress", showContours: true, showGridValues: true });
  },
});
```

</details>

## electrical.insertDisconnect

Places a local NEMA 3R/1 disconnect switch beside an equipment load (NEC 440.14 / 430.102) and re-routes its circuit inline (panel -> disconnect -> equipment) while preserving upstream breaker positions and One-Line topology.

```ts
insertDisconnect(ctx: ScriptContext, equipmentRef: PlacedPart | string, spec?: InsertDisconnectSpec): InsertDisconnectResult
```

Topics: disconnect, safety switch, nec 440.14, nec 430.102, equipment connection, one-line, inline disconnect, starter

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, markups, drafting, checks, electrical } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "layout",
  reads: { levels: true },
  parameters: {},
  run(ctx) {
    const walls = building.walls(ctx, { level: "L1", points: [{ x: units.ft(0), y: units.ft(0) }, { x: units.ft(30), y: units.ft(0) }, { x: units.ft(30), y: units.ft(20) }, { x: units.ft(0), y: units.ft(20) }], closed: true, thickness: units.in(8), height: units.ft(10) });
    const hp = equipment.place(ctx, { level: "L1", type: "builtin:panelboard-225-480@1", at: { x: units.ft(2), y: units.ft(2) }, mark: "HP-1" });
    const rtu = equipment.place(ctx, { level: "L1", type: "builtin:rtu-5-ton@1", at: { x: units.ft(20), y: units.ft(10) }, mark: "RTU-1" });
    ctx.edit({ type: "create_service_link", linkId: "ckt-rtu", sourceId: hp.id, positions: [1, 3, 5], members: [{ elementId: rtu.id }], electrical: { ratingA: 40 } });
    electrical.insertDisconnect(ctx, rtu, { ratingA: 60 });
  },
});
```

</details>

## electrical.removeDisconnect

Removes an inline local disconnect switch feeding a piece of equipment and restores direct feed from its upstream panel circuit (preserving breaker positions and ratings).

```ts
removeDisconnect(ctx: ScriptContext, equipmentRef: PlacedPart | string): { removedDisconnectId: string; restoredLinkId: string | null }
```

Topics: disconnect, remove disconnect, direct feed, equipment connection, bypass disconnect

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, markups, drafting, checks, electrical } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "layout",
  reads: { levels: true },
  parameters: {},
  run(ctx) {
    const walls = building.walls(ctx, { level: "L1", points: [{ x: units.ft(0), y: units.ft(0) }, { x: units.ft(30), y: units.ft(0) }, { x: units.ft(30), y: units.ft(20) }, { x: units.ft(0), y: units.ft(20) }], closed: true, thickness: units.in(8), height: units.ft(10) });
    const hp = equipment.place(ctx, { level: "L1", type: "builtin:panelboard-225-480@1", at: { x: units.ft(2), y: units.ft(2) }, mark: "HP-1" });
    const rtu = equipment.place(ctx, { level: "L1", type: "builtin:rtu-5-ton@1", at: { x: units.ft(20), y: units.ft(10) }, mark: "RTU-1" });
    ctx.edit({ type: "create_service_link", linkId: "ckt-rtu", sourceId: hp.id, positions: [1, 3, 5], members: [{ elementId: rtu.id }], electrical: { ratingA: 40 } });

});
```

## electrical.setDisconnectRequirement

Marks whether a piece of equipment requires a local disconnect switch (set required: false for integral factory disconnects or lockable breakers per NEC 430.102(B) Exception to silence equipment-missing-disconnect warnings).

```ts
setDisconnectRequirement(ctx: ScriptContext, equipmentRef: PlacedPart | string, required: boolean, reason?: string): { equipmentId: string; disconnectRequired: boolean }
```
